_doc: Where every piece of raw art under pixellab/ came from: the PixelLab job, its prompt and seed, and the sha1 of the file kept. Icons were made with create_image_pro (64 candidates at <=42px; the kept file is the chosen one); panels and control sheets with create_ui_asset.

master/master_b.png.palette: dark oak brown, stone grey, antique gold, parchment cream
master/master_b.png.prompt: medieval RPG inventory window: thick dark oak wooden border with grey stone inner rim and small gold corner caps, parchment interior, pixel art game UI, clean straight edges, front view, no text
master/master_b.png.note: chosen over a walnut-and-parchment variant (job f8f1a2c2-29f5-426b-bfae-9d2136c5c363); also reference/master.png

controls/controls_a.png.pieces: buttons, tab, slots, scroll, input, title bar, status, nameplate, hp, bubble, sign, plaque, pad keys at exact sizes
controls/controls_a.png.prompt: sprite sheet of separate matching fantasy RPG game UI elements on transparent background: each shape is its own small framed widget with a thin dark walnut wood border, tiny antique gold corner caps, and a cream parchment or dark wood inner face; crisp 1px pixel art outlines, straight edges, flat front view, no text, no icons

controls/controls_wood.png.prompt: sprite sheet of separate matching fantasy RPG game UI elements on transparent background: each shape is its own small framed widget with a thin grey stone rim, tiny antique gold corner caps, and a DARK polished walnut wood plank inner face with subtle horizontal wood grain; crisp 1px pixel art outlines, straight edges, flat front view, no text, no icons
